verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents fast integration paths: a hosted payment page promising a branded checkout 'in less than a day', no-code Payment Links, pre-built plugins, and a public self-serve test account. However, going live is sales-led: merchants must 'get in touch with our team' to set up a plan, and pricing depends on business profile and risk category. That makes a same-day live card payment after signup unsupported by the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence of self-serve live-account activation, a documented onboarding/KYC timeline under a day, and hands-on or independent reports of same-day go-live.
